about: Hand-coded notebook themes, experiments/open_harvest_5ag, 2026-09-24. Each of the 15 agent blocks (3 seeds x 5 agents) at the start of T2, T3, T4, T5 (lessons written after the previous trial + plans for this trial) was read in full and coded by meaning with one rubric; each model coded by an independent LLM reader (Claude Opus 5.5 subagents) from the dumps made by scripts/open_harvest_notes_timeline.py's prompt extraction. Lists are full counts out of 15 for T2..T5; 'partial' lists weak cases, not included in the counts. Codes: plan_guard = plan to guard a patch / zap intruders (pure self-defence excluded); plan_hang = plan to keep apples hanging / farm regrowth; plan_measure = plan to compare regrowth by eating stage; plan_fast = plan to eat fast / take everything / beat rivals; lesson_futile = lesson that others strip patches anyway so restraint/waiting/guarding does not pay; lesson_zapcost = lesson that being zapped is a major cost / avoid zap fights; lesson_zapnopay = lesson that zapping others does not pay (coded for Claude only).

gpt-6-sol.notes: plan_guard cases are all opportunistic 'zap when it protects a harvest'; guarding a home patch 0 in every trial. plan_hang hedged ('when possible', 'where competition allows') in 0 of 15 at T2 and 8 of 13 at T5. Extra lesson 'regrowth too scarce to rely on': 2, 4, 6, 6.

qwen3.8-27b.notes: plan_guard comes from the same few agents (907 C all trials, 906 C T2-T3, 906 B T3-T4).
